description: For this year's challenge, I'm looking to tackle a problem that leverages interactive data visualization, simulation, or AI. To build a well-rounded solution, I'm looking for passionate teammates to join the roster!
summary: The Motion Mappers is an interactive astronomy project designed to help users explore SPHEREx observations and investigate potential moving objects in the sky. Users can enter sky coordinates (Right Ascension and Declination) to locate an area of interest and compare astronomical images through an interactive visualization. By making changes between observations easier to explore, our project aims to support the discovery process and make astronomical data more accessible to students, researchers, and space enthusiasts. It turns complex observations into a more visual and understandable experience, encouraging curiosity and participation in space science.
details: The Motion Mappers allows users to explore astronomical observations by entering Right Ascension and Declination coordinates. The project is designed to retrieve and visualize images of selected sky regions, allowing users to compare observations and explore possible changes over time. Its goal is to make astronomical data easier to understand and help users investigate potential moving celestial objects. The project combines astronomy data with interactive visualization to create an accessible and engaging discovery experience. Our development uses web technologies and astronomical resources such as NASA/IPAC IRSA and Astropy. The creative approach is to present complex astronomical observations in a visual, interactive format.
